header.window: web pilot 2026-10-06 to 2026-10-19 (14 days), trials resolved by 2026-10-26

store_rules_today.rule: United States storefront apps may include buttons and links to purchase methods other than in-app purchase; elsewhere links need an entitlement in specific storefronts
A subscription bought on the web can be unlocked in the app only if the same subscription is also offered as an in-app purchase
Apple may seek a commission tied to its costs on purchases made through links in the app (Ninth Circuit, 11 December 2025); the district court is setting the rate, none is final
store_rules_today.source: https://www.fenwick.com/insights/publications/ninth-circuit-largely-upholds-ruling-in-epic-v-apple (summary of the Ninth Circuit opinion in Epic Games v. Apple)

store_rules_today.rule: Linking US users out of an Android app needs enrolment in the external content links program; transactions are reported and fees apply from 1 October 2026
The pages read set terms for purchases reached through a link in the app; none sets a fee on a web purchase made before the install with no link from the app
